migrations.label: ADD account_type to customer_accounts (4-phase: ADD, UPDATE, NOT NULL, CHECK)
migrations.evidence: CONFIRMED by Governor query: customer_accounts live columns are [id, company_name, tax_id, industry, brand_assets, credit_terms, created_at, package_id]. account_type is ABSENT. The entity boundary (TENANT vs CRM_CLIENT) was ratified and reported as 'landed' in this session. It landed in the FILE, not the database. Every subsequent reference to TENANT/CRM_CLIENT classification has no mechanism at all.
migrations.consequence: The account_type NOT NULL + CHECK constraint does not exist. customer_accounts rows are unclassified at the DB level. provisioning.py and any code that distinguishes TENANT from CRM_CLIENT is acting on a phantom column.
migrations.previous_incorrect_report: Antigravity reported Migration 37 landed. That report was wrong. The file changed; the database did not.

migrations.label: Create pending_claims + seed role_definitions + seed starter package
migrations.evidence: CONFIRMED by Governor query: pending_claims table does not exist in live database. role_definitions seed and packages seed status unverified independently (role_definitions may exist from a different path; packages seed depends on packages table existing from migration 26). The pending_claims table itself is confirmed absent.
migrations.consequence: D3/D4/D5 were authored as ALTER TABLE on a table that does not exist. Migration 39's cause column has no table. The backfill repair path for broken provisioning state is untracked. E-2's assertion gate would have blocked this: LEDGER_ABSENT: Migration 38 has no ledger row.
